items.title: Trading system with AI analytics
items.task: Automated crypto trading lost money to inaccurate signals, while market analysis took up to an hour and decisions used stale data.
items.role: Principal product engineer, responsible for discovery, architecture, development, launch, and operations.
items.built: A trading decision system with multi-factor market evaluation and strict risk limits, plus AI agents that analyse markets, news, and forecasts in parallel.
items.changed: The system capped risk before a trade, and analytics no longer blocked decisions.
achievements: Developed an isolated decision-making engine (Scoring Engine): implemented a multi-factor system consisting of 6 components with PIT-MAD normalization to prevent look-ahead bias, driven by a 5-state market regime classifier with an HTF consensus gate, which reduced false signals by 50%.

Built a real-time pipeline to multiplex high-frequency WebSocket streams (orderbook, trades, liquidations) via the Binance API; implemented incremental calculation of quant metrics and Funding Z-score directly in Redis RAM, reducing the load on PostgreSQL by 90% while maintaining 99.99% data uptime.

Designed a risk management module based on the Carver algorithm (volatility targeting) for dynamic position sizing; deployed 15 pre-trade risk limits (Pre-Trade Risk Guards / Circuit Breakers) and a multi-priority exit matrix (8 scenarios, including SL, TP, daily DD), strictly capping maximum daily drawdown at 3% of capital.

Implemented a fault-tolerant execution engine on top of CCXT featuring a 4-phase cascade order escalation logic (Limit → Re-quote → IOC → Market) and per-symbol Redis locks, completely eliminating race conditions and slippage during periods of extreme order book volatility.

Developed an asynchronous Event-Driven architecture for the analytical circuit: deployed 12+ microservices powered by Redis Streams and n8n, eliminating blocking HTTP dependencies and accelerating report generation from 30–60 minutes down to 10–15 seconds (p99 < 1s for critical triggers).

Designed a unified API layer for a hierarchical multi-agent system (GPT-5 via OpenRouter): implemented parallel orchestration of 7 specialized modules (including locally deployed TimeGPT, Matrix Profile, and custom TA indicators in pure JS), shortening integration time for new modules from 2 days to 2 hours.
Implemented an asynchronous N×M real-time sentiment analysis module for news feeds via GPT-4o, automatically matching aggregated context against active market orders.

Deployed an observability stack (Pino JSON, Promtail, Grafana Cloud Loki) and an LLM-powered Telegram control interface, ensuring transparent auditing of AI agent behavior and cutting production validation time for new prompts.
items.overview: Deterministic algorithmic trading engine based on a trend-following strategy for the BTC futures market, along with a multi-agent AI-powered market analytics system built on n8n, integrating LLMs, TimeGPT, and external data providers.

items.title: Crypto payment infrastructure
items.task: The company lost substantial transfer fees, while payment settlement was slow and unreliable as load grew.
items.role: Lead engineer for the payment core and custody layer.
items.built: A payment platform that monitors 15+ blockchain networks, automatically sweeps deposits, and optimizes the fee of each operation.
items.changed: Fees fell nearly tenfold, settlement took seconds rather than minutes, and the platform sustained 100M requests a day.
achievements: Designed a microservices-based architecture for the core payment engine using Encore.ts (Clean Architecture), supporting peak loads of 3,000+ RPS (100M+ requests/day) with a system-wide end-to-end uptime of 99.99%.

Developed a high-performance WebSocket engine for monitoring DEX pools and an ingestion system for parallel streaming of on-chain data from 15+ EVM/non-EVM networks; reduced the load on public RPC nodes by 70% by implementing two-tier caching in Redis and brought data latency down to <200 ms.

Designed and implemented a sweep-on-deposit algorithm featuring automated, programmatic energy renting on the TRON network and dynamic gas top-ups in EVM, reducing on-chain business fee operational costs by 90%.

Created an event-driven pipeline for real-time transaction tracking across a database of 3M+ multi-chain wallets, including a parallel deposit splitting module and a concurrent nonce-tracking controller, reducing settlement latency to 2–3 seconds.

Secured the custodial layer against MEV and front-running attacks at the smart contract interaction level (Uniswap V3, gasless Permit2, fee-on-transfer protection) and implemented authorization protocols based on Web3 signatures, HMAC, and AES-256.

Deployed a local testing environment with isolated protocol nodes for BTC, ETH, and TRON, and built a testing pyramid (unit/component/e2e) that secured 80% coverage of critical paths and enabled zero-downtime releases.
items.overview: Web3/FinTech ecosystem: decentralized multichain DEX interfaces (15+ EVM/non-EVM networks), real-time monitoring of on-chain events, liquidity, and price quotes (REST API, WebSocket). Backend platforms for automating multichain deposits and B2B/B2C SaaS services focused on transaction cost optimization (TRON energy rental, EVM gas management). Full-cycle crypto operations processing: real-time monitoring, transaction execution, and automated fund distribution across custodial wallets.

items.title: Currency exchange platform with document control
items.task: Crypto-to-fiat applications took three hours by hand, while the platform also had to pass an external security audit.
items.role: Full-stack engineer for both backend services and operator UI.
items.built: A system where every deal follows a strict workflow, with KYC/AML, role separation, MFA, and eight-language support.
items.changed: Operators stopped being the bottleneck; the platform passed the external audit and entered new regions.
achievements: Designed and implemented a finite State Machine to manage transaction lifecycles alongside a Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) model, reducing order processing times from 3 hours down to 3 minutes.
Developed a modular monolith applying DDD principles and set up an API-first pipeline with automatic type generation for the frontend client, entirely eliminating integration contract errors.
Implemented a pricing engine with Redis caching for external rates (updating every 5–30 seconds), minimizing costs associated with paid infrastructure APIs from data providers.

Integrated an end-to-end KYC/AML perimeter (wallet screening, counterparty identification) and protection mechanisms (MFA, session invalidation, webhook verification), successfully guiding the platform through an external security audit.
Developed an authorization module using Web3 wallets and provided architectural support for localization (8 language zones), accelerating product expansion into new regional markets.
items.overview: A regulated OTC platform for exchanging crypto assets (USDT, BTC, ETH) for fiat currency (USD, KGS) with a full-cycle KYC/AML workflow, banking settlement, and an operational dashboard for managers.

items.title: Attuni — simultaneous speech translation for international events
items.task: Thousands of participants needed to hear a speaker in their own language without delay or audio interruption.
items.role: Founder of Attuni and lead engineer for the real-time platform.
items.built: A speech-recognition, translation, and voice-delivery system in 50+ languages for thousands of listeners with hot language switching.
items.changed: The product supported live events reliably, while AI-service costs fell 40%.
achievements: Developed a multi-tenant media session isolation system using OpenResty, Redis, and PM2 with dedicated Node.js processes per room, eliminating cross-load impact and enabling stable handling of 10,000+ concurrent WebSocket connections.

Designed an event-driven integration layer for AI providers (OpenAI, Deepgram, ElevenLabs) with caching and data deduplication mechanisms for fan-out workloads, reducing end-to-end latency to <250 ms, lowering third-party API costs by 40%, and maintaining 99.99% uptime.

Bypassed native Apple/Safari background audio restrictions by implementing background streaming through Web Audio API with silent audio playback, ensuring uninterrupted audio delivery with the screen locked.

Implemented seamless hot language switching across 50+ translation languages without packet loss or active WebSocket session interruption. Successfully launched MVP into production and validated the technical architecture.
Architected a high-load Control Plane (Node.js, Redis, TCP/WebSocket, 99.99% uptime) enabling real-time orchestration and broadcast command execution across thousands of edge devices.
Built Red Team infrastructure using SOCKS5 and Reverse Proxy technologies, implementing secure tunnels, Remote Shell capabilities, and a protected multi-tenant security layer (AES-256, RBAC).
items.overview: Real-time AI interpretation and streaming platform for international conferences, webinars, and hybrid events. The system enables live speech capture, sub-second speech recognition, translation into 50+ languages, and delivery of synthesized audio streams to thousands of concurrent listeners. Also designed an RMM & Command and Control (C2) platform for centralized management of distributed edge agents and Red Team operations. The architecture includes a real-time Control Plane, secure communication channels (TCP/WebSocket, SOCKS5), automated agent build pipeline, multi-tenant web console, and reverse proxy/tunneling infrastructure.

items.title: Vending-machine fleet management platform
items.task: Thousands of machines in different cities required payments, tax reporting, remote configuration, and real-time sales visibility.
items.built: The platform core that processes all device events and a bidirectional channel for remote machine configuration.
items.changed: Tax reporting became automatic, and the platform had capacity for 10× device growth.
achievements: Designed the Event-Driven Architecture (EDA) core for the multi-tenant SaaS platform; decomposed business requirements into technical specifications, provisioning an architectural buffer for a 10x scaling of the IoT device fleet.
Developed a fault-tolerant message bus using Apache Kafka and NATS with peak throughput up to 60,000 RPS, ensuring guaranteed asynchronous data delivery between system domains.
Unified API contract design standards and directed collaborative Scoping & Estimation processes alongside Frontend and QA teams, lowering the rate of integration defects during release cycles.
Optimized the storage layer in PostgreSQL (60+ tables, 8 hierarchy levels), accelerating the execution of analytical queries.
Implemented a bi-directional communication protocol with IoT terminals, enabling automatic compliance-driven fiscalization for 99% of transactions without requiring manual operator intervention.
Introduced mentoring and Code Review processes within the backend team, accelerating onboarding for new engineers and enhancing the overall code quality culture.
items.overview: A cloud B2B SaaS platform for managing a distributed fleet of IoT terminals for vending machines: online transaction fiscalization, remote device configuration, payment acquiring, service route automation, and real-time sales analytics.

items.title: Book digitisation pipeline
items.task: A publisher needed to digitise and prepare thousands of editions for print without months of manual work.
items.role: Full-cycle engineer, from data collection to the finished file.
items.built: An automated collection, data-normalisation, and print-file pipeline that resumes from checkpoints after failure.
items.changed: The system replaced work that had required external contractors, with no progress loss on failures.
achievements: Designed and launched an end-to-end aggregation pipeline into production, driving autonomous import, normalization, and headless generation of 4,000+ publisher catalog SKUs without outsourcing to external contractors.
Developed a fault-tolerant download orchestrator (Bun, utilizing a pool of 64 isolated workers) with in-memory caching and checkpoint resume mechanics, increasing overall system throughput tenfold.
Deployed a resilient processing layer based on file locks and idempotent restarts, eliminating manual intervention during failures and reducing progress loss to 0%.
Built a CPU/GPU-scalable media compression batch pipeline (Sharp, FFmpeg), cutting storage footprint by 50% while fully preserving the visual quality of typography.

Led the migration of the core WYSIWYG system from CKEditor v4 to v5, refactoring the codebase to TypeScript and designing a custom plugin architecture, which increased rendering stability for complex text structures.
Organized decentralized P2P data replication via a Tailscale mesh network and Syncthing, entirely removing dependence on cloud providers and eliminating commercial egress traffic expenses.
items.overview: An end-to-end content pipeline for high-volume digitalization and distribution of books: automated scraping of publisher catalogs, structured data extraction via external APIs, multimedia content normalization, and headless generation of print-ready PDF editions.

ai.title: How I work with AI
ai.lead: AI speeds up development, but it also makes confident, plausible mistakes. I use these controls to keep it useful.
items: Written scope, an explicit ‘what we do NOT do’, and acceptance criteria before the first line of code.
AI needs a clear task and the relevant system context.
Several AI executors work on separate parts of a task in parallel, following a clear hand-off rule.
Every AI feature has a reference set with known correct answers.
AI receives no broader access than the task needs. Money and client data pass deterministic checks.
I track what AI did, why it did it, and what it cost. Every decision is auditable.
Costs are tracked by function: caching, model selection, and fallback scenarios.
AI is for analytics, text, drafts, and hypotheses. Money, access, and critical operations use deterministic code only.
No line reaches production without my review. ‘AI wrote it’ is not an explanation.

fit.title: Who I work best with
items: Founders from idea to first customers.
You need one person to own the product end-to-end.
Payments, wallets, custody, customer checks, and fee reduction.
The system is slow, fails under load, or is too risky to change. I diagnose the cause and give you a clear plan.
Businesses that want AI implemented for real.
A product feature with measurable quality, predictable cost, and clear boundaries.
Where an outage means lost money, damaged data, or a conversation with a regulator.
fit.noFit: I am not a fit if you need an executor with no voice in decisions, or if the task is to fill a deadline with features without considering what happens in six months. I will say when I think the plan is wrong.

items.question: What materials do you need?
answer: A system overview, process diagram, sample logs and metrics, with secrets removed. Your developer may need to help prepare them. Live access, passwords and keys are not needed for a review.

items.question: Are my materials confidential?
answer: Yes. Materials can be anonymized, and we can agree an NDA before sharing sensitive information.

items.question: What does a review cover?
answer: One agreed process or launch scenario. You receive a written report and video walkthrough; it is not a full system or formal security audit.

items.question: Who does the work?
answer: I perform the review personally. Any additional specialist and their scope are agreed in advance.

items.question: How do I pay?
answer: Bank transfer, payment services, stablecoins or cryptocurrency. We agree the fee and payment terms before work begins.

items.question: Who implements the recommendations?
answer: Your team or another contractor can use the report. If you want my help, we agree scope, access and acceptance criteria separately.
